summary: Rotate agent evidence signing keys: one agent key added, one unused agent key removed

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this edits public keys in a trust file.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes. The skip policy already admits the agent level for listed agent keys.

compatibility.detail: No command, frame, scope or stored-format change in the product. Evidence signed only by the removed key no longer verifies; that key was unused.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator action is required by this change. The owner of the added agent key keeps its signer configuration outside the repository.

recovery.detail: No persistent product state changes or new swap-back restrictions.
